manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Gravity slows the ball on the way up and speeds it up on the way down. At the top, the ball is still for an instant while gravity still pulls it down.
manifest.description: A simulation of a vertical ball toss showing velocity vectors shortening to zero at the apex while a constant downward gravity vector remains unchanged.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.
